title: Reconcile the European callback ownership
changes: Update the conditional full-byte language-position ownership inventory after the independently rooted callback descriptor was integrated in E167.
validation: Protected static audit 60xqqy83 checks both original readers and all 256 byte inputs against the E167 manifest. Of 261 physical pairs, 260 have an owner and one two-byte pair remains unowned.
Protected static audit s82earyr authenticates both conditional indices, neighboring list sources and a bounded exact-pointer search; it does not establish the gap's meaning or ordinary reachability.
limitations: This does not establish ordinary reachability of indices above 4 or the meaning of the final two-byte gap. Other writers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurements.
